register.labelZh: MESS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: mess around 可以描述人們玩鬧、做愚蠢的事情,或沒有做任何有用的事情。；當有人未經許可或不小心地碰弄控制掣、設定、機器或私人物品時,你可以使用 MESS 片語動詞。；mess something up 既可以描述被弄亂的房間,也可以描述出了問題的計劃。；MESS 片語動詞可以描述某人的時間被浪費、有人受到挑釁,或不合適的性關係。
register.summaryEn: Mess around can describe people who are playing, behaving foolishly or doing nothing useful. You can use MESS expressions when someone touches controls, settings, machines or personal belongings without care or permission. Mess something up can describe both a room that has become untidy and a plan that has gone wrong. MESS expressions can describe someone whose time is being wasted, a person who is being challenged, or an unsuitable sexual relationship.
